title: Mushroom French Dip Sandwich
description: Savory mushrooms, caramelized onions, and provolone on a toasted roll.
instructions:
In a medium bowl, add hot water and dried porcini and set aside until mushrooms are softened, about 10 minutes. Remove mushrooms, using your hands to squeeze excess liquid back into bowl, transfer to cutting board, and roughly chop. Set aside and reserve soaking liquid.

Meanwhile, in a large stainless steel or cast iron skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add sliced portobellos in a single layer and cook, undisturbed, until slightly golden brown on bottom, about 4 minutes. Stir, and continue cooking until browned all over, 3 to 4 more minutes.

Use a wooden spoon to push mushrooms to the perimeter of skillet and add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to center of skillet. Add half of mixed mushrooms to oil and cook, undisturbed, until slightly browned on bottom, about 1 minute. Stir and continue cooking until slightly browned all over, 2 to 3 minutes. Again, push browned mushroom mixture to edge of skillet and repeat with oil and remaining mushrooms.

Stir all mushrooms together, then add onion, garlic, and thyme and cook, stirring occasionally, until onions start to soften, about 2 minutes. Add tomato paste and stir to combine, then cook until tomato paste is slightly caramelized, about 1 minute, lowering heat if needed to avoid scorching.

Pour in vermouth and reserved mushroom soaking liquid. Cook until slightly reduced, about 1 minute. Pour in vegetable or mushroom broth and add reserved porcini mushrooms. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and reduce heat to maintain a low simmer. Cook until sauce is slightly thickened and reduced, about 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and preheat oven broiler to high. Cut open rolls and lay flat, cut-side up, on a baking sheet. Broil until slightly toasted, about 30 seconds.

To Build Sandwiches: Use tongs or a slotted spoon to divide mushroom mixture evenly among bottom of rolls (reserve the sauce). Top with cheese. Broil until cheese is bubbly and slightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes. Close sandwiches with top halves of rolls. Transfer remaining mushroom jus to individual sauce bowls and serve on the side.

ingredients.item: portobello mushrooms, stems and gills removed
ingredients.note: about 3 ounces; 85 g each, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices
ingredients.raw: 2 large portobello mushrooms (about 3 ounces; 85 g each), stems and gills removed, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices

ingredients.item: mixed mushrooms, such as oyster, shiitake, and/or cremini
ingredients.raw: 6 ounces (170 g) mixed mushrooms, such as oyster, shiitake, and/or cremini, roughly chopped
1 medium yellow onion (8 ounces; 226 g), diced (1 cup diced)

ingredients.item: dry vermouth or dry white wine
ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup (60 ml) dry vermouth or dry white wine

ingredients.item: homemade or storebought low-sodium vegetable or mushroom broth
ingredients.raw: 2 cups (480 ml) homemade or storebought low-sodium vegetable or mushroom broth

ingredients.item: Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
ingredients.raw: 3/4 teaspoon Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume

ingredients.item: store-bought or homemade French rolls or hoagie/sub rolls, split lengthwise, but left attached on 1 side to create a hinge
ingredients.raw: 2 (7- to 8-inch long) store-bought or homemade French rolls or hoagie/sub rolls (about 6-ounces each), split lengthwise, but left attached on 1 side to create a hinge

ingredients.item: thin slices aged provolone or Swiss cheese
ingredients.raw: 4 thin slices aged provolone or Swiss cheese (about 2 ounces; 56 g total weight)
